Disney's fiscal Q1 2024 operating margin was roughly 10%. This is an estimate from memory, not a figure I could confirm.

Disney does not report a GAAP operating income line, so I approximated it as revenue less costs and expenses and restructuring and impairment charges.

- Fiscal Q1 2024 revenue was about $23.5 billion.
- Pre-tax income was about $2.2 billion. I backed this out of GAAP EPS of roughly $0.72, so it is the least certain input.
- Adding back net interest expense and equity income puts operating income at about $2.3–2.4 billion.

That gives roughly 10% of revenue.

If you instead mean Disney's total segment operating income of about $5.1 billion, the margin would be about 21.8%.
